rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I'm from the Operations Testing
Bureau.

rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Our main job is testing equipment
developed by Research Headquarters.

rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Things like guns and armor
for the regular infantry.

rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0004
rows.name:
The Imperial Army doesn't
have all that many Drivers.

rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0005
rows.name:
The most important thing is developing
powerful weapons anyone can use.

rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0006
rows.name:
...I guess that doesn't have much
to do with you though, huh?

rows.label: tlk45320651_01_msg0007
rows.name:
It's not fair that Blades get stronger
just by giving them Core Chips.
